description: Cities and areas with active Roomly listings, with how many each has. Use it when you are not sure Roomly covers a place, or to suggest where to look. Returns each location with its name (use it as search_listings location), country, listing count, search url and city page.

country.description: US (New York) or IL (Israel). Empty = both.

name: list_locations

includes_areas.description: True for a metro that counts its areas (New York = its boroughs).
